nodes.label: Softree Brand Hero Animation Frames 564-640 (Veo AI Cinematic Sequence)

properties.note: Frames 564-640 do not exist in the split folder (max frame index is 240). Animation is a Veo AI-generated cinematic brand sequence for Softree featuring a glowing dark tech cube with the Softree 'S' logo and a luminous fiber-optic tree on a dark background, used as hero/brand animation on the Softree website.
properties.content_description: AI-generated (Veo) cinematic 3D animation; dark background; subjects include a translucent black cube with blue circuit-trace glows and the Softree 'S' brand mark, and a glowing fiber-optic/bioluminescent tree; used as hero visual branding for Softree
